summary: The main_performance_failures P0 alert also reports a failed daily-perf- lane of the daily long lanes on main, naming the failed lanes

replay.detail: Delivery receipts and baselines keep their run/attempt/head keys; the new failed_jobs fact is not part of the key.

schema.detail: No registry change: main_performance_failures stays an array. Its entries gain an optional failed_jobs list, absent for perf.yml runs, and stored entries without it still parse.

compatibility.detail: The field also lists failed daily-long.yml runs on main (schedule or workflow_dispatch) and reads the jobs of the ten newest; a run counts only when a job named daily-perf-* concluded failure. A daily run red only in other lanes is not reported. perf.yml push failures are reported as before with the same title. A daily failure's title names its lanes (P0: main daily-perf-load failed: ...). A missing daily-long.yml workflow, a refused read or a jobs listing over 100 fails the shared observation, as the perf.yml listing does.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the daemon deploy.

manual.detail: No subscription change. After deploy, a recipient already subscribed receives a P0 for any of the ten newest failed daily runs on main with a red daily-perf- lane that it has no receipt for, since the field is not new and no baseline is taken.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; older builds ignore failed_jobs and treat daily entries as invalid, skipping them.
